2733.title: Claude refusal events lose policy metadata
2733.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude translator converts a structured no-fallback refusal to a general warning and drops its policy metadata.

prReviews.verdict: ADDRESSES ROOT CAUSE — static review only
prReviews.topFinding: The translation patch emits a policy provider error. The larger recovery plugin needs normal review.

2733.proposedFix: Declare the refusal category in the Claude schema and emit a policy provider error with the provider text and code.
2733.caveats: The exact translator path was reproduced twice. No live provider refusal was necessary or attempted.
